svg.title: Synthetic demonstration + 2 more repositories
svg.desc: Star history for Synthetic demonstration + 2 more repositories over 1 year. 2,397 current stars. 1,503 recorded additions in range. 2025-09-14 to 2026-09-06. Scale: absolute. Display intervals subdivide nominal API weeks; the final week may still be partial. Column height approximates cumulative recorded stars in whole tiles; shading marks distance below each column tip, not value ranges.
